blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Что это ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way)?
exercises.why: The verb "to carry" in Russian is rendered in two ways depending upon the way of carrying: on foot — носить-нести, понести; by vehicle — возить-везти, повезти. — DLI, Lesson 78.  ·  From Фёдор Достоевский, «Преступление и наказание».
exercises.context: The verb "to carry" in Russian is rendered in two ways depending upon the way of carrying: on foot — носить-нести, понести; by vehicle — возить-везти, повезти.
